sources.text: You may feel let down as your folks may not extend the support you expected from them, says Ganesha You should try to remain practical and not get swayed by emotions. It is highly likely that family feuds may erupt today. Ganesha advises you to avoid confrontations and keep smiling to emerge a winner.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Perhaps money is tighter than usual right now, and you have to put off purchases you want to make. Try to work it out. This is a great day to reach a compromise in just about any touchy situation, because you should be in just the right space to see both sides of any issue.

sources.text: Vow to nurture these aspirations when Luna aspects Mars, refusing to make space for anyone who doesn't support your dreams.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Fear may mar your happiness. You need to understand that it is the product of our own thoughts and imagination. It kills spontaneity-blot out joy of living and handicap our efficiency-so better nip it in the bud before it makes you a coward. Today, with the help of a close relative, you can do well in your business, which will also benefit you financially. Home-improvement projects should be considered. You can read a book in your free time. However, you may constantly feel disturbed by the members of your family. Life has been really tough with you in recent days, but today you will find yourself in the paradise of your spouse. Time is absolutely free, but it is precious too. So, accomplish all your pending tasks today and relax tomorrow.

readings.text: Today you may be looking forward to easy gains. Minimum efforts and shortcuts may give you success but not satisfaction. You may not be able to focus on your prime responsibilities and thus the gossips in the office may attract you. Make sure that the important works get finished in time.

bits.t: Today, with the help of a close relative, you can do well in your business, which will also benefit you financially.

readings.text: If you are in job, you will have two better paying jobs on your way. If you are in business, you will have two or more business deals coming your way. This is the right time to ask your friends to help you.

You would probably prefer not to have to worry about money, especially this week. But since it's a necessary part of life, you prefer to worry about broader things - that which you can't control. At this time, your money life is more ideas than reality, thanks to aspects happening in the area of your chart associated with past lives, institutions, the unconscious mind, and dreams. Your efforts to make any serious changes to your money situation now may need more time to develop.

Today, with the help of a close relative, you can do well in your business, which will also benefit you financially.

readings.text: It’s a good day for your health. This is also a good day to start doing regular exercise and increase your energy level or boost your resistance power. On the whole, the day is going to pass without any challenges on the health front.

Today's aspect makes this a time of great insight for you. Stay away from conflicts with friends, for the celestial atmosphere will not help you in the communication department. It may feel difficult to be understood for a little while. Keep your own counsel and seek to feel balanced and secure in your body. Exercise and diet have a good deal to do with this. Why eat something that will only make you feel moody later on?

lucky.remedy: Recite Hanuman Chalisa and gain good health..

extras.text: What's on your mind? Good or bad, it's time to talk all about it with a friend.

hc_career.text: Make sure you have love for the work you are doing. If your work is not inspired by a true love from within, then quit your job and find something else. Follow your passion. Follow your heart, and the money and opportunities will follow naturally.

ac.text: Romantic entanglements will be a source of confusion throughout the coming weeks, dearest Taurus. As Mercury stations retrograde in Scorpio, your relationship could hit a crossroads. Reconnect with your partner by returning to activities that helped you bond in the early days of dating. Former lovers might also resurface, hoping for a second chance at love. Think carefully about your long term goals while the Aries Moon and Saturn unite, especially if matters of the heart have derailed your plans in the past. Vow to nurture these aspirations when Luna aspects Mars, refusing to make space for anyone who doesn't support your dreams.
